reason: Two gummies a day with sugar and glucose syrup, from a brand I've never heard of, at £19.99 a jar when I'm used to waiting for Boots 3-for-2. I'd want to see it at a proper discount before I'd even think about paying full whack.
objection: Gummies have sugar in them, that's not healthy, and I'd be paying the full price for a sweet with magnesium in it.
would_change_my_mind: A sugar-free or much lower-sugar magnesium option at a Boots-style price, or a 3-for-2 type offer.
